This is an announcement for passengers on Skyways flight 382 to Singapore."], ["A", "Due to a technical issue with the aircraft, this flight has been delayed."], ["A", "The new departure time is eleven forty-five, about ninety minutes later than scheduled."], ["A", "In addition, the flight will now depart from gate 27 instead of gate 12."], ["A", "Gate 27 is in Terminal B, so please allow about fifteen minutes to walk there."], ["A", "Boarding is expected to begin at eleven ten."], ["A", "We know this isn't the news you were hoping for."], ["A", "To make up for the inconvenience, passengers can collect a meal voucher worth fifteen dollars at the Skyways service desk."], ["A", "Please have your boarding pass ready when you pick it up."], ["A", "If you have a connecting flight in Singapore, our staff at the desk can help you rebook it if necessary."], ["A", "We'll make further announcements if anything changes."], ["A", "Thank you for your patience, and we apologize for the delay."]], {"A": "F-GB"}]
